Who We Are

Eight Years Keeping
Nigerian Hospitals Running

Digha Biomedical is a division of Digha Mux Limited — incorporated in Nigeria as a Technological Innovation and Inventing Company. We don't just supply medical equipment. We design it, manufacture it, install it, and keep it running.

For over eight years we have been a reliable, affordable pillar for hospitals across Nigeria — providing ready solutions to equipment deficiencies and breakdowns that would otherwise halt patient care.

Trusted by leading hospitals
Our Lady of Lourdes Ihiala Toronto Hospital Onitsha St. Joseph Hospital Adazi 82 Division Medical Center NAOWA Hospital Abuja Immaculate Heart Aguleri Regina Caeli Hospital Awka + More

What We Do

Six Core Services

From installation to training — we handle the full lifecycle of your hospital's equipment.

01
🏗️
X-Ray Room Installation

Full radiology room setup — shielding, columns, tables, control booths, wiring and calibration. End-to-end commissioning.

02
🔧
Equipment Repair & Maintenance

Rapid-response breakdown repair for X-ray machines, ultrasound units and all biomedical equipment. Preventive maintenance contracts available.

03
⚙️
Biomedical Manufacturing

In-house design and manufacture of X-ray controllers, solar systems, phase monitors and electronic circuit boards. All ISO certified.

04
🔬
Equipment Supply & Procurement

Sourcing and supply of ultrasound machines, gynecological chairs, imaging accessories and clinical hardware at hospital-friendly prices.

05
🎓
Engineering Training

Hands-on biomedical engineering training — 75% practical. Run in partnership with state governments, MedShare and international organisations.

06
🤝
Hospital Partnership & Consulting

Long-term partner to hospitals — radiology department planning, equipment investment advisory and ROI optimisation for hospital management.

Engr. Ubah Chuma
Founder & CEO · Inventor · INV-INN
The Founder

Built by One Man's
Refusal to Stop

Born in Nnobi, Anambra State on May 6, 1972. He built a working FM radio station in JSS3. Scored 97% at GTC Enugu — the highest in the school's history. Worked and studied simultaneously at UNN. Dropped out of university twice for lack of funds and kept going both times.

Digha Biomedical is the result of fifty years of curiosity, sacrifice and Nigerian engineering brilliance. The story is far from over.
